assets.editPrompt: Edit this sheet only to simplify plant geometry and surfaces into WorldEngine rich stylized Style B. Preserve exact grid, regions, headings, layouts, winter strip and aerial views. Replace every shrub's tiny individual leaves with 3–5 merged irregular organic lobes with broad smooth lit planes and a few silhouette notches. Hedge must read as a continuous irregular broken-crest mass, not beads or thousands of leaves. Coontie and grasses use only 8–12 broad folded ribbons per clump. Flowerheads use 3–5 simple cream lobes per group. Remove all photographic leaf, bark, grass and gravel microtexture: ground beds solid warm brown or muted sand with 3–5 scattered rock shapes; lawn smooth color. Keep real directional light, broad cool shadows, restrained contact darkening, dimensional forms and recognizable regional character. No stippling, no noise, no image texture, no hyperrealism. Miami stays evergreen, Chicago and Denver winter show bare simple twigs mixed with evergreen masses and snow.
